content.value_statement: Crypto BD teams need repeatable ways to find and qualify token listing prospects. This skill provides patterns for scoring, wallet review, outreach approval, and pipeline tracking.
actual_capabilities: Defines a 100-point token scoring model for listing prospects.
Outlines multi-source token discovery across market, social, and on-chain signals.
Describes wallet forensics checks for deployer funding, balances, and transfer history.
Provides pipeline stages from discovery through listing negotiation.
Recommends human approval before outbound exchange outreach.
Shows how to separate free data sources from paid x402 intelligence calls.
limitations: It is a guidance skill, not a ready-to-run scanner or trading bot.
It does not provide smart contract code or deployable payment integrations.
Results depend on external data quality and current market conditions.
Users must handle legal, compliance, and exchange policy review separately.

use_cases.title: Create a Listing Qualification Workflow
use_cases.description: Design a repeatable process for ranking new token projects before BD outreach.

use_cases.title: Add Wallet Review to Token Research
use_cases.description: Use deployer funding and transfer history checks to reduce listing risk.

use_cases.title: Plan an Agent-Assisted BD Pipeline
use_cases.description: Map discovery, scoring, draft outreach, approval, and negotiation stages for an AI-assisted team.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize the Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how to use this skill to create a crypto token listing qualification workflow for an exchange BD team.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Scoring Rubric
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a token scoring rubric using liquidity, volume, market cap, social activity, age, team transparency, and catalyst adjustments.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Wallet Forensics
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a wallet forensics checklist for token deployer review, including funding source, balances, transfer history, identity, and score changes.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Agent Operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an agent-assisted crypto BD operating model with free-first intelligence, x402 cost controls, LLM routing, approval gates, and ROI tracking.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a new token with strong volume, six months of age, and incomplete team information.
output_examples.output: The skill would produce a weighted qualification summary, note the team transparency gap, request wallet forensics, and recommend priority queue review.

output_examples.input: Plan outreach for five qualified Solana token projects.
output_examples.output: The skill would organize prospects by score, identify required verification data, draft outreach only after approval, and track each project through pipeline stages.

output_examples.input: Compare paid intelligence calls with free data sources for daily token discovery.
output_examples.output: The skill would favor free sources first, reserve paid calls for high-signal gaps, and track whether each paid call produced a qualified prospect.

best_practices: Require at least two independent data sources before qualifying a prospect.
Keep human approval before any external outreach or paid workflow.
Separate payment wallets, identity wallets, and operational accounts.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to build trading bots or automated market execution.
Do not rely on token names without verified contract and pair addresses.
Do not send outreach or make paid calls without approval and budget controls.

faq.question: Does this skill trade crypto assets?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on business development workflows for token listing research and outreach.

faq.question: Can it replace compliance review?
faq.answer: No. Legal, compliance, sanctions, and exchange policy reviews must remain separate controls.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include runnable code?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns, checklists, scoring logic, and process guidance.

faq.question: How does it reduce poor listing decisions?
faq.answer: It combines token metrics, source confirmation, wallet forensics, and human approval before outreach.

faq.question: What should users configure before implementation?
faq.answer: Users should define data sources, budgets, wallet controls, approval gates, and retention rules.
